Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/code-visible/bucket/solution.py`.

It tracks tokens starting at `capacity`, refills each event by elapsed time × rate capped at capacity, advances the previous timestamp, accepts costs that fit (including zero cost), rejects oversized costs without spending, records accepted/rejected indices and post-event balances, and returns the final token count.
